interpretation_guardrails: The original science-tech field denominator is 10 selected units: 9 persons plus 한국공학교육인증원 as one organization.
The 9-person career-scope metrics are a unit-type-specific secondary analysis and must not be reported as the full science-tech10 result.
한국공학교육인증원 is tracked separately under the organization outcome architecture and is not assigned person Major/Apex/Advanced labels.
Pre-T0 field-defining achievements remain in baseline even when major post-T0 honors later recognize the same scientific contribution; this prevents false advancement inflation.
Sector transition is allowed: 안철수's post-T0 apex is political, not scientific, and is coded under the frozen political scope rule.
Public fame, department-chair titles, or listed-company CEO status alone do not automatically satisfy science score3/4.
채연석 lower_than_baseline reflects that his T0 lifetime peak was already national research-institution leadership; it does not erase his earlier contribution to Korean rocketry.
